title: Constraint: No Consecutive Zeros
constraints: `v` is 16 bits and must never contain two **adjacent** zero bits (the pattern `00` may not occur anywhere).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Bit-parallel formulation: position i has two adjacent zeros when both `v[i]` and `v[i+1]` are 0, i.e. `~(v | (v >> 1))` has a 1 there (mask off bit 15).

Verilator's constraint-to-SMT translation mis-sizes shift operators on vectors narrower than 32 bits (z3 then rejects the query and `randomize()` fails). Use part-selects and concatenation instead: `v >> 1` becomes `{1'b0, v[15:1]}`.
Fifteen explicit terms `!(v[i] == 0 && v[i+1] == 0)` also work.

examples.title: variety
